title: Activity feed stores the record name in the writer's language: a reader in another locale sees the other language
body:
Found by the hotclm app (objectstack-ai/hotclm#157, PR #202) on `@objectstack/*` 18.3.0.

**What happens.** hotclm names four child objects with a formula `display_name` that uses `label(record.FIELD)` (objectstack#26608), so toasts, related lists and the record H1 follow the reader's locale. The activity panel on the record page does not: an en-US reader of a review created by a zh-CN user reads `Created Review "法务 · Legal Counsel 1"`, and a zh-CN reader reads `更新了 合同版本 "v6 · Clean"` after a system-context update. The verb and the object label render per reader; the record name does not.

**Seam.** `sys_activity.record_label` (and the quoted name inside `summary`) is stored when the write happens, in the writer's Accept-Language (a system write gets the declared English labels).

**Expected.** The activity entry renders the record name for the reader, for example by resolving the name at read time when the object's name field is a formula, or by storing the record reference and rendering the label on read.

Dedupe: no issue mentions `record_label` or the activity feed's locale.
